soldier: Head brownish, the frontal region darker, mandibles blackish brown, pronotum pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs white tinged with yellow. Head capsule moderately haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle pore projecting towards the vertex, resembling a crater. The anterior half of the labrum is semicircular, the labral apex straight, the hairs on the labral margin long and numerous. Mandibles sabre-shaped, stout, the apices slightly curved. Below the midpoint of the inner margin of the left mandible there remains the trace of a small tooth, at the corresponding position on the inner margin of the right mandible there are traces of two small teeth, and the bases of both mandibles bear a large tooth-like process and a notch. Antennae 11–12-segmented, the basal segment and segment 3 of similar length, segment 2 shortest; the flange over the antennal socket cannot reach the lateral margins of the head. Pronotum 1.9–2.0 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly concave with a U-shaped centre, the midline visible, the posterior margin semicircular, the median area with about 20 long hairs.
